entrees.description_source: Use these settings to install or enable the bundled Browser plugin, set up the browser extension, and manage browser permissions. Under Agent permissions, choose default permissions and add exceptions for specific websites. Controls include Browse, Download, and Upload, with options such as Requires approval, Always allow, and Block. Removing a site's custom permissions resets them to the defaults. Your organization can restrict these controls.

en.texte: Use these settings to install or enable the bundled Browser plugin, set up the browser extension, and manage browser permissions. Under Agent permissions, choose default permissions and add exceptions for specific websites. Controls include Browse, Download, and Upload, with options such as Requires approval, Always allow, and Block. Removing a site's custom permissions resets them to the defaults. Your organization can restrict these controls.

fr.texte: Utiliser ces paramètres pour installer ou activer le plugin Browser intégré, configurer l'extension de navigateur et gérer les autorisations du navigateur. Sous Autorisations de l'agent, choisir les autorisations par défaut et ajouter des exceptions pour des sites web spécifiques. Les contrôles comprennent Parcourir, Télécharger et Téléverser, avec des options telles que Approbation requise, Toujours autoriser et Bloquer. Supprimer les autorisations personnalisées d'un site les réinitialise aux valeurs par défaut. L'organisation peut restreindre ces contrôles.

entrees.usage: Use these settings to install or enable the bundled Browser plugin, set up the [browser extension](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/chrome-extension), and manage browser permissions. Under **Agent permissions**, choose default permissions and add exceptions for specific websites. Controls include **Browse**, **Download**, and **Upload**, with options such as **Requires approval**, **Always allow**, and **Block**. Removing a site's custom permissions resets them to the defaults. Your organization can restrict these controls.

entrees.description_source: Check your Computer Use settings to review desktop-app access and related preferences after setup. On macOS, revoke system-level access by updating Screen Recording or Accessibility permissions in macOS Privacy & Security settings.

en.texte: Check your Computer Use settings to review desktop-app access and related preferences after setup. On macOS, revoke system-level access by updating Screen Recording or Accessibility permissions in macOS Privacy & Security settings.

Sous macOS, révoquer l'accès au niveau système en mettant à jour les autorisations Enregistrement de l'écran ou Accessibilité dans les réglages Confidentialité et sécurité de macOS.

entrees.usage: Check your Computer Use settings to review desktop-app access and related preferences after setup. On macOS, revoke system-level access by updating Screen Recording or Accessibility permissions in macOS Privacy & Security settings.

entrees.description_source: Choose whether Enter sends prompts, or require Cmd+Enter on macOS or Ctrl+Enter on Windows and Linux for multiline prompts or every prompt. On macOS and Linux, turn on Prevent sleep while running so local chats can continue while you step away. Under Follow-up behavior, choose whether a message sent while ChatGPT works should steer the current run or wait for the next run.

en.texte: Choose whether Enter sends prompts, or require Cmd+Enter on macOS or Ctrl+Enter on Windows and Linux for multiline prompts or every prompt. On macOS and Linux, turn on Prevent sleep while running so local chats can continue while you step away. Under Follow-up behavior, choose whether a message sent while ChatGPT works should steer the current run or wait for the next run.

fr.texte: Choisir si Entrée envoie les invites, ou exiger Cmd+Entrée sur macOS ou Ctrl+Entrée sur Windows et Linux pour les invites multilignes ou pour chaque invite. Sur macOS et Linux, activer Empêcher la mise en veille pendant l'exécution afin que les conversations locales puissent continuer pendant une absence. Sous Comportement de suivi, choisir si un message envoyé pendant que ChatGPT travaille doit orienter l'exécution en cours ou attendre la suivante.

en.texte: In the ChatGPT desktop app, pop out an active chat into a separate window and place it next to your browser, editor, or design preview. Turn on Always on top when you want the chat to remain visible while you work in another app.

entrees.description_source: Type : on-request | never | { granular = { sandbox_approval = bool, rules = bool, mcp_elicitations = bool, request_permissions = bool, skill_approval = bool } }. Controls when Codex pauses for approval before executing commands. You can also use approval_policy = { granular = { ... } } to allow or auto-reject specific prompt categories while keeping other prompts interactive. untrusted is unsupported, and on-failure is deprecated; use on-request for interactive runs or never for non-interactive runs.

en.texte: Type : on-request | never | { granular = { sandbox_approval = bool, rules = bool, mcp_elicitations = bool, request_permissions = bool, skill_approval = bool } }. Controls when Codex pauses for approval before executing commands. You can also use approval_policy = { granular = { ... } } to allow or auto-reject specific prompt categories while keeping other prompts interactive. untrusted is unsupported, and on-failure is deprecated; use on-request for interactive runs or never for non-interactive runs.

fr.texte: Type : on-request | never | { granular = { sandbox_approval = bool, rules = bool, mcp_elicitations = bool, request_permissions = bool, skill_approval = bool } }. Il est également possible d'utiliser approval_policy = { granular = { ... } } pour autoriser ou rejeter automatiquement des catégories d'invites spécifiques tout en gardant les autres invites interactives. untrusted n'est pas pris en charge, et on-failure est obsolète ; utiliser on-request pour les exécutions interactives ou never pour les exécutions non interactives.

en.texte: Type : map<string, allow | deny>. Domain policy for sandboxed networking. Unset by default, which means no external destinations are allowed until you add allow rules. Supports exact hosts, *.example.com for subdomains only, .example.com for apex plus subdomains, and global * allow rules. Prefer scoped rules because * broadly opens public outbound access. Add deny rules for blocked destinations; deny wins on conflicts.

fr.texte: Type : map<string, allow | deny>. Politique de domaines pour le réseau en bac à sable. Non définie par défaut, ce qui signifie qu'aucune destination externe n'est autorisée tant qu'aucune règle allow n'est ajoutée. Privilégier des règles ciblées, car * ouvre largement l'accès sortant vers le public. Ajouter des règles deny pour les destinations bloquées ; deny l'emporte en cas de conflit.

Il ne s'exécute pas pour les sous-agents.

Les applications absentes de la liste nécessitent une approbation ; pour supprimer les entrées enregistrées, passer par les paramètres Computer Use de l'application de bureau ChatGPT.
